I fixed the format-selector parser in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py`, and all 14 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` now pass.

The bug was in `build_format_selector`. When it parsed a `/` choice, such as `bestvideo/best`, it appended the choice to the list and set the current selector to `None`. A following `,` then appended that `None` to the list as well. Building a selector for `bestvideo/best,bestaudio` then crashed with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'type'`.

Now the `/` branch sets the current selector to the `PICKFIRST` choice instead, so the `,` appends the real choice.
